neighbours.label: jurisdiction and governing-law clauses in terms of sale, firing around the court or place ('exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of', 'la compétence des tribunaux')
fire: You agree to submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Ontario.
The place of jurisdiction for any dispute under this contract is Munich, Germany.
Tout différend sera soumis à la compétence exclusive des tribunaux de Paris.
This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.
Any claim shall be settled by binding arbitration in the State of Oregon.
The governing law is that of the country where the buyer has its office.
Both parties accept the jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales.
Für alle Streitigkeiten ist das Gericht in Hamburg zuständig, Deutschland.
quiet: You agree to attend the annual meeting of the members in Ontario.
The place of delivery for any order under this deal is Munich, Germany.
Tout client sera accueilli à la réception principale de l'hôtel de Paris.
This festival is attended by the people of the State of Delaware.
Any guest shall be offered a free breakfast in the State of Oregon.
The largest lake is that of the country where the buyer has a cabin.
Both parties enjoy the beaches and the castles of England and Wales.
Für alle Besucher ist das Museum in Hamburg geöffnet, täglich.

notes: Card: ',' x16, ')' x7, 'ence' of compétence, ' of', ' is', ' which', in governing-law text and also in copyright lines. Probe: 'jurisdiction of the courts of' 0.675; 'compétence des tribunaux' 0.615; 'place of jurisdiction ... Berlin,' 0.594; 'governing law ... located' 0.353; copyright line 0.267; 'place of the wedding' 0.137. Copyright lines are left out of the test.
